points.description: States that the data rate of the compressed output must not exceed the channel capacity of the communication link.

States that the full capacity of the communication channel should be utilised (the compressed rate should make use of the available channel capacity). Equivalent wording such as 'use the channel to its maximum' earns the mark.
States that maximum quality of the data should be preserved through the compression. Equivalent wording such as 'retain the highest possible fidelity' or 'minimise loss of quality' earns the mark.
